g.text: Track 04: AI Finance Controller · Razorpay AI Buildathon · Deterministic Financial Authority with Advisory AI Exception Loop
CORE INVARIANT BOUNDARY: AI IS ADVISORY — NEVER THE FINANCIAL AUTHORITY
AI investigates exceptions · Critics challenge · Deterministic gates decide · Cryptographic Merkle receipts replay offline
· All INR amounts in integer paise
Strict typed schema — zero free-form ledger writes
Recomputes fee schedules, GST & net settlement
Enforces banking holidays & SLA cutoff bounds
· Prompt injection neutralized by data isolation
· All claims pass to Non-LLM mechanical validator
· Bitwise validation against raw ingested data
Fabricated references / hallucinations instantly rejected in <1ms
· Low Exposure: Auto-commit with audit receipt
· ADMIN: Strictly required to sign & approve
· Exactly 1 balanced pair (2 lines: 1 Dr, 1 Cr)
Verified before any ledger state transition
· Strict mathematical balance: Σ Debits ≡ Σ Credits
· Zero duplicate payouts or double-claim races
RFC 8785 Canonical JSON · Lexicographically sorted keys
· Bitwise identical hashes across runtimes & platforms
· Tampering any byte breaks signature instantaneously
· Full audit verification for external regulators
6A. DURABLE BOUNDED EXECUTION & VERIFIED SCALE TIERS
EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED WORKLOAD TIERS (NO FLOATING-POINT DRIFT AT ANY SCALE)
HMAC-SHA256 session; client cannot spoof actor/role
REVIEWER prepares cases; only ADMIN approves commits
Bank narrations isolated as data; output schema enforced
Webhook guard blocks loopback, private IPs & cloud metadata
100 req/min perimeter protection with standard 429 headers
HMAC-SHA256 signature invalidates on any single bit edit
AUTH_SECRET mandatory in production; zero insecure defaults
